entries.en: Using the alumina salts you brought him, Gerolt adds the finishing touches to your relic weapon. Even as he declares his work over, however, the man believes that there is still something incomplete about it. In order to shed light upon the mystery, Gerolt suggests that you seek out literature surrounding the hero associated with the relic. Perhaps the trader Rowena back at Revenant's Toll will be able to assist you in this endeavor.
entries.fr: Gerolt a forgé Curtana mais il n'est pas satisfait du résultat. Il vous a demandé de lui rapporter des documents sur Jhal Tristram, le paladin qui utilisait cette arme autrefois. Allez au camp du Glas des revenants et parlez à Rowena.

entries.en: After a cursory examination of the text, Gerolt declares that he will require some time to make sense of its contents. In the meantime, you are to familiarize yourself with the restored weapon in its current state. Arm yourself with the unfinished Curtana, make your way to Zahar'ak in southern Thanalan, and there slay eight Zahar'ak lancers, eight Zahar'ak pugilists, and eight Zahar'ak thaumaturges.

Upon your return, Gerolt deduces that you must face mightier adversaries if you are to experience a revelation pertaining to your relic. To this end, he bids you challenge the hydra within Halatali, the abandoned training grounds situated in eastern Thanalan. Armed with the unfinished Curtana, enter Halatali and defeat the hydra.

※The hydra can be confronted via the Duty Finder upon examining the quest destination.

In order to create the raging fire that he needs, the weaponsmith bids you fetch him a white-hot ember, a howling gale, and a chunk of hyperfused ore. entries.en: Jus' let me make one thing clear: it might be as I'm repairin' kettles to pay for yesterday's mead, but I still got me pride as a master weaponsmith. Ye'll get no less than the finest out of me forge.
entries.fr: Ouvre bien tes esgourdes<nbsp>: c'est pas parce que je fabrique des bouilloires pour un troquet que j'suis plus le meilleur forgeron du pays.
entries.ja:
チッ、いいか？
今じゃ、酒場のヤカンを作っちゃいるが……
腐ってもオレは一流の武具職人だ。

entries.en: An' it might be as ye've got that godsdamned slip of paper, but it'll only get ye so much. Restorin' relics like these calls for some rare ol' materials, an' I ain't got none. So if you want the job done, ye'll have to run along an' fetch 'em for me.
entries.fr: J'suis pas du genre à faire les choses à moitié, compris<nbsp>? Restaurer des armes antiques, c'est du boulot et va falloir te démener pour m'rapporter tout le nécessaire.
entries.ja:
ハンパな仕事をするつもりはねぇ。
それも「古の武器」を復元するとなりゃ、おおごとだ。
テメェにも、材料集めだなンだで、働いてもらうからな。

騎士きどりか、テメェは？　……まぁいい。

entries.fr: Cette épée était celle de Jhal Tristram, un des trois grands paladins qui ont fondé les casques d'argent.

伝承によりゃ、初代ウルダハ王は、
近衛兵団「銀冑団」の結成にあたって、「聖剣」と同じ石材から
三振りの剣を作らせ、3人の騎士に与えたンだそうだ。
